summary: GEMINI MODEL FIX VERIFIED + STANDALONE REGRESSION PASSES on the mobile web preview (390x844). (1) /app/frontend/src/db/gemini.ts:6 now correctly reads `const MODEL = 'gemini-flash-latest'`.
